target_customer: US consumers with obesity or chronic conditions paying for telehealth care and prescriptions
problem: Access to affordable, medically supervised weight management and chronic condition care is limited.
business_model: Direct to consumer telehealth subscription with prescriptions and coaching

competitors.name: Form Health
competitors.what: Virtual obesity medicine with physicians and dietitians
competitors.funding_then: 12M Series A led by M13 in June 2021

competitors.name: Calibrate
competitors.what: Telehealth year long metabolic reset program
competitors.funding_then: 100M Series B in Aug 2021 after 5.1M seed

technical_complexity.rationale: A telehealth storefront, intake and provider messaging app with partner pharmacies; the hard parts are licensing and clinical operations rather than engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded telehealth weight loss rivals sold the same prescriptions and coaching, so customers could switch easily.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Better funded players scaled in 2021; no source shows them acquiring Measured.

market_need_then: Digital weight management companies raised about 740M dollars in 2021 rounds per trade coverage, showing strong investor and consumer demand.

branding.domain_note: Uses trymeasured.com with a try prefix.
branding.community_and_virality: Trustpilot review pages exist; an advertorial review appeared in 2026 and the FDA named Better Health Labs in a March 2026 GLP-1 marketing warning letter.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic real-word name, legal entity is Better Health Labs, and the only brand press found is a paid advertorial and a regulatory letter.

pivots.from: Telemedicine for chronic conditions like obesity (diet, coaching, medication)
pivots.to: GLP-1 prescription weight loss plus longevity products such as NAD+ injections
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from YC description versus current site, date unknown

outcome_analysis: Measured is still operating as a direct to consumer GLP-1 telehealth brand run by Better Health Labs in New York. No outside funding was found and aggregators conflict, so traction is uncertain. A March 2026 FDA warning letter on compounded GLP-1 marketing is a regulatory risk, but no shutdown or acquisition was found.
notes: Funding sources conflict: Latka says no outside funding and 1.5M revenue (self-reported aggregator), ZeroG Talent lists 21M seed in May 2022 (single aggregator); neither is recorded as a round. The FDA letter naming Better Health Labs is per a directory entry and a list of recipients; the sources did not give exact details. The pivot is inferred from the current site and the date is unknown. Second search confirmed the 21M May 2022 round (Telescope Partners) and about 21M to 28M totals belong to a different Austin media measurement company named Measured, so nothing is recorded for this company.
